title: Five Laredo teams open the UIL bi-district playoffs tonight
excerpt: Five Laredo teams open the UIL bi-district playoffs this week, with three playing tonight at 7 p.m. and two home games at the Student Activity Center.
content:
Five Laredo high school football teams open the UIL bi-district playoffs this week, and the road to the state championships starts tonight — with three Laredo squads kicking off at 7 p.m. on Thursday.

Here's the full Laredo slate:

  • Thursday, 7 p.m. — Laredo LBJ (7-3) at San Antonio Brennan (9-1), Farris Stadium, San Antonio. Class 6A Division I.
  • Thursday, 7 p.m. — Laredo Nixon (5-5) at Smithson Valley (9-0), Ranger Stadium, Spring Branch. Class 5A Division I.
  • Thursday, 7 p.m. — Laredo Cigarroa (6-4) at Corpus Christi Ray (9-1), Buccaneer Stadium, Corpus Christi. Class 5A Division II.
  • Friday, 7:30 p.m. — Laredo United (7-2) vs. San Antonio Harlan (8-2), United ISD Student Activity Center, Laredo. Class 6A Division I.
  • Saturday, 2 p.m. — Laredo Alexander (6-4) vs. San Antonio Warren (6-4), United ISD Student Activity Center, Laredo. Class 6A Division II.

The Thursday openers are all on the road, and all three are underdogs on paper. Brennan is 9-1. Smithson Valley is undefeated at 9-0. Ray is 9-1 and finished second in its district. Cigarroa, which finished third in District 16-5A Division II, is in the playoffs for the first time in 20 years after edging Roma 29-28 last week. Ray lost its finale 28-14 to Gregory-Portland.

The weekend brings the playoffs home. United hosts Harlan on Friday night at the Student Activity Center, and Alexander hosts Warren there Saturday afternoon. Both are home games for Laredo fans who want to see playoff football without leaving town.

Winners advance to the area round next week, one step closer to the state championships. For the seniors on all five rosters, every game from here on could be the last one — and for the five Laredo programs, this is the biggest combined playoff showing of the season.
